description: This file defines the 'Document' class, which is an accessibility interface for document content in the AT-SPI framework, including methods to retrieve document attributes, locale, page number, and page count.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: A tagging interface indicating the start of document content in the accessibility hierarchy, providing methods to access document attributes, locale, and pagination information.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific attribute for the document as a whole.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes associated with the document as name-value pairs.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Gets the locale associated with the document's content.

methods.name: getCurrentPageNumber
methods.description: Gets the current page number of the document.

methods.name: getPageCount
methods.description: Gets the total page count of the document.
